# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

## forced 2D correction for (Z eta, Z phi)
return now to the sandbox at MainAnalysis/20260414_pPbPbpCombining. REPLACE the Z data correction scheme with a new one written by you. The new scheme should exist as a 2D correction as a function of (Z eta, Zphi) applied to pPb to correct it to Pbp. Calculate the correction by filling a 2D histogram  with Z eta, Z phi info, normalized by N_Z for pPb and Pbp seperately and then calculate the correction weight w = pPb(2D) / Pbp(2D). Do this applying with (VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor) in place. We divide 2D histograms since we want to preserve the off-diagonal contributions of eta and phi correlations. Additionally we dont care about pT any more. For binning use the same binning as PLOTTED in the Z y and Z phi plots right now such that when we remake the Z corrected plots, pPb/Pbp is EXACTLY flat at unity. Remake the zcorr presentation with this correction in place and verify visually that the Z y and Z phi distributions close exactly well. 

### summary of presentation debug observables and corrections
Use MainAnalysis/20260414_pPbPbpCombining as a working directory. The list of observables to track in the pPb and Pbp workflow to the following list.
 - trk eta
 - trk pt
 - Z y
 - Z pt
 - event multiplicity
 - Z-track (delta eta, delta phi) ratio map
 - Z-track delta eta correlation
 - Z-track delta phi correlation

And for each of these include 6 levels of corrections as done before:
For six levels of corrections: 
 - no corrections, no EventWeight, no TrackWeight
 - only VZ correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor + TrackWeight
 - VZ correction + Z correction + Z scale factor + TrackWeight + TrackResidual
Use Z pt 0-500 and trk pt 0.5-15 as kinematic selection

## run-by-run deltaeta average value
Without applying Z data correction, go through pPb and Pbp data sets run-by-run and calculate the average |delta eta| value (one number per run). Tabulate the numbers for review.
